description: DataDan - PostgreSQL MCP server that gives coding agents permission-bound access to databases via a YAML config

userStories.title: Project scaffolding and dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project initialized with package.json, tsconfig, and all dependencies so that subsequent stories can build on a working TypeScript project.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with name 'datadan', type 'module', and bin entry pointing to dist/index.js
tsconfig.json configured for Node.js LTS (ES2022 target, NodeNext module)
Dependencies installed: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, pg, js-yaml, zod, commander, node-sql-parser
Dev dependencies installed: typescript, @types/pg, @types/js-yaml, @types/node
Source directory structure created: src/config/, src/db/, src/permissions/, src/tools/
Empty src/index.ts entrypoint exists with a placeholder shebang (#!/usr/bin/env node)
npm run build compiles without errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Config types and Zod validation schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TypeScript types and Zod schemas for the datadan.config.yaml structure so that config can be validated at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config/schema.ts exports a PermissionLevel type: 'read' | 'write' | 'delete' | 'none' | 'yolo'
Zod schema for TableConfig with fields: name (string), permission (PermissionLevel, optional)
Zod schema for SchemaConfig with fields: name (string), permission (PermissionLevel, optional), tables (TableConfig array, optional)
Zod schema for DatabaseConfig with fields: name (string), connection_string (string), permission (PermissionLevel, optional), schemas (SchemaConfig array, optional)
Zod schema for DataDanConfig with fields: name (string), default-permission (PermissionLevel), hot-reload (boolean), databases (DatabaseConfig array)
All types are exported alongside schemas (inferred via z.infer)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Config parser with YAML loading and env var interpolation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DataDan to load datadan.config.yaml, resolve ${ENV_VAR} references, and validate the result so that misconfigured files are caught early.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config/parser.ts exports a loadConfig(configPath: string) function
Reads the YAML file using js-yaml
Replaces ${VAR_NAME} patterns in connection_string values with process.env values
Throws a clear error if a referenced env var is not set
Validates parsed config against the Zod schema from schema.ts
Returns the validated DataDanConfig object on success
Throws a descriptive error on validation failure (includes which field failed)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Permission resolver with cascading precedence
userStories.description: As a developer, I want permissions to cascade from database to schema to table so that I can set broad defaults and override per-table.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config/resolver.ts exports a resolvePermission(config, database, schema, table) function
Returns table-level permission if set
Falls back to schema-level permission if no table-level rule
Falls back to database-level permission if no schema-level rule
Falls back to config default-permission if nothing else is set
Returns exactly one PermissionLevel for any valid input
Exports a PERMISSION_HIERARCHY constant mapping each level to its allowed SQL operations
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: SQL query classifier
userStories.description: As the system, I need to parse SQL and determine the statement type and referenced tables so that I can check permissions before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: src/permissions/classifier.ts exports a classifyQuery(sql: string) function
Uses node-sql-parser with PostgreSQL dialect to parse the SQL
Returns an object with: statementType ('select' | 'insert' | 'update' | 'delete' | 'ddl'), requiredPermission (PermissionLevel), and referencedTables (array of {schema, table} objects)
SELECT maps to 'read', INSERT/UPDATE to 'write', DELETE to 'delete', CREATE/ALTER/DROP/TRUNCATE to 'yolo'
Multi-statement SQL returns the highest required permission
Extracts tables from JOINs, subqueries, and FROM clauses
Throws a clear error if SQL cannot be parsed
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Permission checker and blocked query error builder
userStories.description: As the system, I need to check a classified query against resolved permissions and return structured errors when blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: src/permissions/checker.ts exports a checkQueryPermission(config, databaseName, classifiedQuery) function
Iterates over all referenced tables in the query and resolves each table's permission
Returns { allowed: true } if all tables have sufficient permission
Returns { allowed: false, error: MCP error object } if any table lacks sufficient permission
src/permissions/errors.ts exports a buildPermissionError(tool, target, requiredLevel, currentLevel) function
Error includes the MCP isError: true shape with a text content block

Error message follows format: 'Permission denied: table '<schema>.<table>' has permission '<current>', but <action> requires '<required>'. Update datadan.config.yaml to grant '<required>' permission if needed.'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Database connection manager
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DataDan to manage pg Pool connections to each configured database so that tools can query them.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/connection.ts exports a ConnectionManager class
Constructor accepts a DataDanConfig and creates a pg.Pool for each database entry
getPool(databaseName) returns the Pool for a given database or throws if not found
connect() method tests connectivity to all pools and returns a status object with successes and failures per database
A failed connection for one database does not prevent others from connecting
disconnect() method ends all pools gracefully
Supports SSL via connection string parameters (sslmode=require)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Schema introspection queries
userStories.description: As the system, I need to query a live database for its schemas, tables, and column definitions so that schema sync and describe_table can work.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/introspect.ts exports getSchemas(pool) — returns array of schema names (excluding pg_* and information_schema)
Exports getTables(pool, schemaName) — returns array of table names in that schema
Exports getColumns(pool, schemaName, tableName) — returns array of {name, dataType, nullable, defaultValue, isPrimaryKey, isForeignKey, isUnique, foreignKeyRef}
All functions query information_schema views
Foreign key details come from information_schema.key_column_usage and referential_constraints
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: MCP server skeleton with stdio transport
userStories.description: As the system, I need an MCP server that starts over stdio and can register tool handlers so that Claude Code can invoke DataDan tools.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server.ts exports a createServer(config, connectionManager) function
Creates an MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk with stdio transport
Exports a startServer() function that connects the transport and begins listening
Server has name 'datadan' and version from package.json
Server handles MCP protocol errors gracefully (logs to stderr, does not crash)
Tool registration is set up but no tools registered yet (empty tool list is valid)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: list_databases, list_schemas, and list_tables tools
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to list accessible databases, schemas, and tables so that I can discover available data.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/list.ts exports registerListTools(server, config, connectionManager) function
list_databases tool: returns names of databases where at least one target has permission >= read; excludes databases where all targets are 'none'
list_schemas tool: accepts database_name parameter; returns schema names with permission >= read; excludes 'none' schemas; returns MCP error if database not found
list_tables tool: accepts database_name and schema_name parameters; returns table names with permission >= read; excludes 'none' tables; returns MCP error if schema not found
All three tools are registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: describe_table tool
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to see column definitions, types, and constraints for a table so that I can write correct queries.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/describe.ts exports registerDescribeTool(server, config, connectionManager)
describe_table tool accepts database_name, schema_name, table_name parameters
Checks resolved permission is >= read; returns permission error if 'none'
Uses introspect.getColumns() to fetch column metadata
Returns structured result with columns: name, type, nullable, default, constraints (PK/FK/unique)
Returns MCP error if table does not exist
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: query tool (SELECT only)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to run SELECT queries so that I can read data from the database.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/query.ts exports registerQueryTool(server, config, connectionManager)
query tool accepts database_name and sql parameters
Uses classifier to parse the SQL — rejects non-SELECT statements with MCP error
Uses permission checker to verify read access on all referenced tables
Executes the query via pg Pool and returns rows as structured JSON content
Returns MCP error with permission explanation if blocked
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: execute tool (INSERT/UPDATE)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to run INSERT and UPDATE statements so that I can modify data when permitted.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/execute.ts exports registerExecuteTool(server, config, connectionManager)
execute tool accepts database_name and sql parameters
Uses classifier — rejects statements that are not INSERT or UPDATE with MCP error
Uses permission checker to verify write access on all referenced tables
Executes the statement and returns affected row count
Returns MCP error with permission explanation if blocked
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: delete tool (DELETE only)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to run DELETE statements so that I can remove data when permitted.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/delete.ts exports registerDeleteTool(server, config, connectionManager)
delete tool accepts database_name and sql parameters
Uses classifier — rejects statements that are not DELETE with MCP error
Uses permission checker to verify delete access on all referenced tables
Executes the statement and returns affected row count
Returns MCP error with permission explanation if blocked
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: run_migration tool (DDL)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to run DDL statements so that I can modify database structure when explicitly permitted with yolo.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/migration.ts exports registerMigrationTool(server, config, connectionManager)
run_migration tool accepts database_name and sql parameters
Uses classifier — only allows DDL statements (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE)
Uses permission checker to verify yolo access on all referenced targets
yolo on one target does not grant access to other targets
Executes the statement and returns execution result
Returns MCP error with permission explanation if blocked
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: dbml export tool
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to export the database structure as a DBML file so that I can understand the full schema at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/dbml.ts exports registerDbmlTool(server, config, connectionManager)
dbml tool accepts database_name parameter
Uses introspection to get all accessible schemas, tables, and columns (excludes 'none' targets)
Generates valid DBML syntax with Table blocks, column types, and relationship references
Writes the .dbml file to the project working directory
Returns the file path and a summary of exported tables
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: register tool (runtime database registration)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to register a new database connection at runtime so that databases can be added without manual config editing.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/register.ts exports registerRegisterTool(server, config, connectionManager, configPath)
register tool accepts database_name and connection_string parameters
Validates the connection by attempting a pg.Pool connection before persisting
Returns MCP error if connection test fails
Adds the new database to the in-memory config with default-permission applied to all discovered schemas/tables
Writes updated config back to datadan.config.yaml using js-yaml
Adds the new pool to the ConnectionManager
Returns success confirmation with list of discovered schemas
Tool is registered on the MCP server in server.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Schema sync on startup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DataDan to reconcile my config against the live database so that new tables are auto-added and stale entries are dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/sync.ts exports a syncSchema(config, connectionManager, configPath) function
Queries each connected database for current schemas and tables via introspection
Tables/schemas in config that no longer exist in the DB are removed from the config object
New tables/schemas found in the DB are added with the applicable default permission (schema-level default, then top-level default-permission)
Existing config entries with explicit permissions are never altered
Writes the reconciled config back to datadan.config.yaml using js-yaml dump
Returns a summary of changes (added, removed counts)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Hot-reload middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DataDan to re-read the config before each tool invocation when hot-reload is enabled so I can change permissions mid-session.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server.ts wraps each tool handler with hot-reload logic
When config hot-reload is true, re-reads and re-parses datadan.config.yaml before each tool invocation
Re-runs schema sync on reload to pick up DB changes
When hot-reload is false, uses the config loaded at startup (no re-read)
If reload produces an invalid config, logs warning to stderr and continues with last valid config
The reloaded config is passed into the tool handler so it always uses current permissions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CLI — datadan init
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to scaffold a starter datadan.config.yaml so I can get started quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: src/index.ts uses commander to register an 'init' subcommand
Running 'npx datadan init' creates datadan.config.yaml in the current working directory
Scaffolded config has placeholder values: name, default-permission (read), hot-reload (true), one example database entry with ${DATABASE_URL}
Includes YAML comments explaining each field
Warns and exits without overwriting if datadan.config.yaml already exists
Prints success message with next steps
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CLI — datadan start
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to start the MCP server from the command line so it can handle agent requests.
acceptanceCriteria: src/index.ts registers a 'start' subcommand via commander
Accepts --config <path> flag to specify config file location
Falls back to DATADAN_CONFIG env var, then ./datadan.config.yaml
Loads config via parser, creates ConnectionManager, connects to all databases
Runs schema sync before accepting requests
Creates and starts the MCP server
Exits with clear error message if no valid config is found
Exits with clear error message if all database connections fail
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CLI — dry-run mode
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a preview mode that shows resolved permissions without starting the server so I can validate my config.
acceptanceCriteria: 'start' subcommand accepts a --dry-run flag
When --dry-run is set, connects to databases and runs schema sync but does not start the MCP server
Outputs a formatted summary table to stdout: database | schema | table | resolved permission
Highlights any 'yolo' permissions with a warning prefix (e.g., '⚠ yolo')
Exits with code 0 after printing the summary
Typecheck passes
